description.value: A luxury wilderness lodge in Bella Coola on BC's Central Coast, nestled between the Coastal Mountains within the Great Bear Rainforest. The property offers 10 spacious guest rooms with mountain views and private bathrooms, plus a common area with complimentary coffee and tea. A rare full-service accommodation option for cyclists reaching the end of Highway 20.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Eagle Lodge is an active accommodation in Bella Coola with 10 guest rooms, private bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi (corroborated by OSM internet_access=wlan). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website. The website uses 'Eagle Lodge' while OSM uses 'Bella Coola Eagle Lodge'; the OSM name is more specific and useful for directory purposes. Contact details in the fetched text do not explicitly show phone or address, so those remain unconfirmed.
